Class ScheduleValidator

java.lang.Object
com.kineticfitness.service.ScheduleValidator
public final class ScheduleValidator extends Object
The rules the "Schedule New Workout" form must satisfy, and the parsing of the free-text fields on it.

Previously the form accepted anything non-empty, so "banana" was a valid date and was persisted as one. Everything here is a pure function taking now as a parameter rather than calling LocalDateTime.now(), which is what makes the "not in the past" rule testable.

US-10 — Schedule a workout.

  • Method Details

    • validate

      public static ValidationResult validate(String name, LocalDate date, String timeText, String durationText, LocalDateTime now)
      Validates the whole form in the order the fields appear, so the user is told about the first problem rather than the last.
      Parameters:
      name - the workout name as typed
      date - the chosen date, or null if nothing was picked
      timeText - the start time as typed
      durationText - the duration in minutes as typed
      now - the current date and time, passed in so this stays testable
